# Marathon taper

## The race
TCS Toronto Waterfront Marathon, Sunday 2025-10-19, 8:45 am start on University Ave. Bib 4127, corral D. My first marathon! Goal A: 4:15 (6:02/km). Goal B: sub 4:30. Goal C: finish smiling and not in the med tent, because I know exactly what the med tent looks like from the inside.

Plan: Marguerite's 18-week novice plan for the High Park Harriers group, 4 runs a week plus one strength day.

## The peak
Peak week was 2025-09-22 to 2025-09-28: 68 km total.

The longest run of the whole block was on Saturday 2025-09-27: **32 km** in 3:21:40, avg pace 6:18/km, avg HR 151, max 167. Route: Sunnyside to Leslie Street Spit and back on the Martin Goodman, with a loop at the Spit to make the distance. 4 gels, 1.6 L of fluid, no knee issues ([[Dolor de rodilla]] seems properly behind me). Last 5 km at 6:05/km, felt strong. That's the run I'll think about at km 35.

## Taper weeks
### Week 1 (Sep 29 to Oct 5): about 75%
- total 52 km
- long run 24 km on Saturday Oct 4, with the middle 8 km at goal pace 6:02
- Tuesday club intervals: 5 × 1 km at 5:35, 2 min jog
- strength: deadlifts down to 3 × 3 at 75 kg, no swings

### Week 2 (Oct 6 to Oct 12): about 55%
- total 40 km
- long run 16 km on Sunday Oct 12, the last 6 at goal pace
- no strength except McGill big 3 and mobility

### Race week (Oct 13 to 19): about 35%
- Tue 8 km with 3 × 1 km at goal pace
- Thu 5 km easy + 4 strides
- Sat 3 km shakeout at 9 am, pick up the bib at the expo the day before
- total 16 km before the race, 58 km counting it

## Feeling weird during the taper
Marguerite warned about "taper madness" and she was right. Phantom pains: right knee (fine), left calf (fine), a sore throat that turned out to be the dry air in the hospital. Legs felt heavy and flat on the Oct 7 run, which is normal apparently. Too much energy in the evenings and nowhere to put it. I reorganized the spice drawer twice.

## Sleep and work
Off nights from Oct 12 to race day, Joyce sorted the schedule. Last shift Thursday Oct 16 day. 8 hours a night target. Notes in [[Sleep]].

## Carb load and fuel
- Thu to Sat: 8 g carbs per kg, at 61 kg that's about 490 g a day. Bagels, white rice, juice, pretzels, rice pudding, honestly hard to eat that much
- low fiber from Thursday, no salads, no bran
- race morning, 5:45 am: 2 white bagels with jam and a banana, 500 ml with one Nuun tab
- race: Maurten Gel 100 every 35 min starting at 0:35, so 7 total, plus 1 caffeinated at 3:00
- sodium plan and the sweat test numbers are in [[Electrolytes for long runs]]

## Pace plan
| section | target | notes |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 5 km | 6:15 | crowded, let them go |
| 5 to 21 km | 6:02 | Lakeshore out-and-back, wind off the lake |
| 21 to 32 km | 6:00 | Beaches turnaround |
| 32 to 42.2 km | whatever is left | Dev and mom at km 38 on Lakeshore and Bay |

## Kit list
- Brooks Ghost 17 (180 km on them, broken in)
- Lululemon Fast and Free shorts with the gel pockets
- Harriers singlet with my name on the front
- arm sleeves, throwaway hoodie from Value Village ($6) for the start corral
- Garmin charged, playlist downloaded but probably not using it

Started this whole thing on the [[Couch to 5k]] app 21 months ago. A little emotional writing that.
